observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to recover from a wrapped cluster cursor, potentially restoring missing rows. This could help warehouse customers whose PostgreSQL clusters have wrapped and whose warehouse ingestion missed rows.

observations.posthog_connection: Supports the recovery command by clearing stored cursor state, enabling a subsequent full-table read. This could help warehouse customers whose PostgreSQL clusters have wrapped and whose warehouse ingestion missed rows.
